metadata.question: Did northern Cambodia have more active fire detections than southern Cambodia between August 2016 and February 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS or VIIRS fire detection products (FIRMS data) - MODIS: "MODIS/006/MOD14A1" or "MODIS/061/MOD14A1" (daily fire mask) - VIIRS: "NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14IMGML" (active fire detections) - Date range: August 2016 to February 2018 - Location: Cambodia - need to define northern and southern regions 2. Masking strategy: - For fire detection products, we want to COUNT fire pixels - MODIS FireMask band: values 7-9 are fires (7=low confidence, 8=nominal, 9=high confidence) - VIIRS has confidence levels too - No cloud masking needed - looking for fire detections 3. Logic: - Define Cambodia geometry and split into north/south (roughly at latitude 12.5°N) - Count fire detections in each region - Compare counts - Valid zero means no fires detected (answer B if south has more) - C1 if no data found - C2 if valid images but no pixels after filtering - C3 if calculation returns null/invalid ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Cambodia regions (north/south split at ~12.5°N) const cambodia = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([102.3, 10.4, 107.6, 14.7]); const northCambodia = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([102.3, 12.5, 107.6, 14.7]); const southCambodia = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([102.3, 10.4, 107.6, 12.5]); // 2. Date range const startDate = '2016-08-01'; const endDate = '2018-02-28'; // 3. Load MODIS fire product let fireCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD14A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(cambodia) .select('FireMask'); const colSize = fireCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Total images found: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { // Try VIIRS as fallback fireCol = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP14IMGML') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(cambodia); const viirSize = fireCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`VIIRS images found: ${viirSize}`); if (viirSize === 0) { console.log('No fire detection data available.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 4. Process fire detections // For MODIS: FireMask values 7,8,9 indicate fire const fireImage = fireCol.map(function(img) { const fireMask = img.gte(7).and(img.lte(9)); return fireMask.selfMask(); }).sum(); // 5. Count fire pixels in north and south const northCount = fireImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: northCambodia, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).values().get(0); const southCount = fireImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: southCambodia, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).values().get(0); const northVal = northCount.getInfo(); const southVal = southCount.getInfo(); console.log(`Northern Cambodia fire detections: ${northVal}`); console.log(`Southern Cambodia fire detections: ${southVal}`); // 6. Validation and answer if (northVal === null || southVal === null) { console.log('Calculation failed - null result.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (northVal === 0 && southVal === 0) { console.log('No fire pixels detected in either region.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (northVal > southVal) { console.log('Northern Cambodia had more active fires.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Southern Cambodia had more or equal active fires.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
